description: Renders standardized receipts with full support for zeroed-out local taxes (IVA = 0), localized formatting conversions, and deep cross-device alignment parameters.
A complex linear setup mechanism enabling validation steps for name registry, image parsing configurations, and dynamic options assignment setup.
Displays custom multi-device client selection modals with dynamic searching indexes, fallbacks, and instantaneous creation fields inside overlays.
Provides UI query parameters across transactions containing full query index text fields, specific payment systems selections, and localized calendar range controls.
Abstracted wrapper managing alerts prompting users to select either individual targeted calendar days or range boundaries.

Embeds Stripe's Connect account-onboarding component in-app via @stripe/connect-js's ConnectComponentsProvider, backed by an AccountSession created server-side (collection_options.fields = 'eventually_due' so the bank/CLABE external-account field is always surfaced). Replaces the earlier hosted-URL window.open() redirect flow.

Collects a card via Stripe Elements (@stripe/react-stripe-js) backed by a server-created SetupIntent, confirms it client-side, then persists it as the client's saved payment method for automated daily repayment collection. Shows last4/brand once saved.

Full-screen native biometric (Face ID / fingerprint) gate mounted above the router, blocking app resume/launch and sensitive actions until the device biometric prompt succeeds. Wraps @aparajita/capacitor-biometric-auth.

Client-side face-liveness challenge (left/right/up/down + blink detection) using @vladmandic/face-api entirely on-device — no Azure calls. Renders a circular progress-ring overlay and compares descriptors against the captured ID selfie (CONSISTENCY_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD=0.95, MATCH_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD=0.6).

Live-camera guided ID capture with real-time distance/framing hint labels, feeding Tesseract.js (idOcr.ts) client-side OCR and/or the backend Azure Document Intelligence endpoint for INE field extraction.
Records a short video plus @capacitor/geolocation coordinates as proof-of-presence during onboarding, reverse-geocoded via the backend's /api/geocode endpoint for a human-readable address.

props.name: onCaptured
props.type: (data: { videoBlob: Blob; latitude: number; longitude: number; accuracy: number }) => void
